requiredApprovals.description: Approvals a pull request needs before it can be merged

signedCommits.description: Require verified signatures on every commit of the default branch

codeOwnerReview.description: Require an approval from a code owner of the changed files

overdueReminderDays.description: Days between reminders to the maintainers while requests stay past their response deadline

unlistedFirstReminderDays.description: Days after which the issue of an unlisted public repository gets its first reminder

unlistedReminderDays.description: Days between further reminders while a public repository stays unlisted

responseWarningDays.description: Working days before the response deadline at which maintainers are notified

archiveInactiveMonths.description: Months without activity after which a repository is suggested for archiving

archiveNeglectedMonths.description: Months without activity after which a repository without a reachable maintainer or with long unanswered requests is suggested for archiving

archiveUnansweredDays.description: Days an external request waits for a first response before its repository counts as neglected

license.description: SPDX identifier of the license, such as Apache-2.0

responseDays.description: Working days until a qualified first response to external issues and pull requests, null for best effort
